title: Floating button fans into a stacked icon menu
summary: A round action button on a flat pale field drops down while three icon buttons pop out of it one by one into a centred vertical stack, hold, then snap back into the button, which springs home. Seamless 4 s loop.
use_when: Showing an expand-to-menu interaction in a mobile or web app demo
A looping micro-interaction clip for a landing page, docs or a feature card
Introducing quick actions or navigation shortcuts without any copy
A short silent insert between larger product shots

look.type_style: no type; white outline icons, ~2.5 % H stroke-weight line icons centred in each button

sfx.event: each menu button pops out of the main button
menu collapses back into the main button
main button settles back at centre

structure.shot: round violet action button, 4-dot icon, on flat pale lilac; fans into a 4-button vertical stack, holds, collapses
structure.camera: static (stack recentres itself; no frame scale or pan)
structure.motion: f0 rest; f1-f30 button slides down 50 % -> 81 % H on springs.ui while 3 buttons emerge from behind it, stagger 8 fr (f2, f10, f18), each scale ~0.3 -> 1 and rising to its slot on springs.ui ~20 fr (overshoot not measurable); stack settled f36; hold f36-f75; f76-f78 menu buttons shrink to dots and vanish, easings.inExpo 3 fr; f76-f100 main button returns to centre on springs.pop (~12 % overshoot upward, scale dip ~10 %), lightens back to rest colour; f100-f120 still

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field, accent for the deepest button, lighter accent tints up the stack
params.content.trigger: LineIcon name on the main button (default grid of 4 dots look)
params.content.items: 2-5 LineIcon names, bottom to top, for the menu buttons (reference: 3)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 | 9:16; stack stays centred, button diameter 17 % of frame height
params.timing.rest: frames at rest after the collapse (default 20); keep rest pose equal to frame 0 for the loop
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t = 0-1.2 s and 2.3-3.5 s. Button diameter ~17.5 % H, slot pitch ~21 % H; the open stack is vertically centred (top slot 18 % H, main button 81 % H). Each button is a top-light to bottom-dark vertical gradient; the stack darkens bottom-up (main button deepest), and the main button is lighter at rest than when open. Items emerge from behind the previous button, not from a fade. Collapse is far faster (3 fr) than the expand (~30 fr): keep that asymmetry. Proposed term: fab-expand (see recipe.md). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Catalogue hints cursor-path and device-phone not seen: no cursor, no device frame.
